job.job_description:
Role: Full Stack Developer (Python Mandatory + React (Frontend/Typescript))

Exp: 4+ years

Location: Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Kerala




Must have skills: Python, AWS, React/Typescript, Agentic AI, LLM, ARG, Fast API




4-6 years of backend engineering experience; Python strongly preferred, with FastAPI or an equivalent async framework.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs agent design, prompt engineering, structured output, and tool / function calling including RAG / knowledge-base grounding, guardrails, and graceful fallback handling when model confidence is low.
AWS proficiency: EventBridge, ECS Fargate, Lambda, RDS PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
Event-driven architecture fundamentals: at-least-once delivery, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and saga patterns.
PostgreSQL depth: schema design, constraint authoring, and index strategy.
Solid grasp of REST API design, asynchronous programming, and automated testing.
Ability to own a service end-to-end in a fast-moving, milestone-gated sprint without hand-holding.
Hands-on experience using an agentic AI platform (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot Agents, Windsurf) across the software development lifecycle from coding and testing to debugging and code review.
